chunks.head: take care of
chunks.note: take care of sb/sth = 照顾、打理。
chunks.ex_en: She takes care of her little brother after school.
chunks.ex_cn: 放学后她照顾她的弟弟。

chunks.head: get away from
chunks.note: get away from = 从…脱身、逃开。
chunks.ex_en: I just want to get away from the noisy city for a weekend.
chunks.ex_cn: 我只想逃离喧闹的城市过个周末。

chunks.head: put an end to
chunks.note: put an end to sth = 使某事停止、了结。
chunks.ex_en: The new rule put an end to the loud parties.
chunks.ex_cn: 新规定终止了那些吵闹的聚会。

chunks.head: run for one's life
chunks.note: run for one's life = 为保命而狂奔。
chunks.ex_en: When the dog broke loose, the boy ran for his life.
chunks.ex_cn: 狗挣脱后,那男孩拼命奔逃。

chunks.head: take shelter
chunks.note: take shelter (in/under …) = 找地方躲避(风雨、危险)。
chunks.ex_en: We took shelter under a tree when it began to rain.
chunks.ex_cn: 下起雨来时我们躲到了一棵树下。

chunks.head: hold out
chunks.note: hold out = 撑住、坚持下去(不倒下、不放弃)。
chunks.ex_en: Can you hold out for ten more minutes until help arrives?
chunks.ex_cn: 你能再撑十分钟直到救援到吗?

chunks.head: in the meantime
chunks.note: in the meantime = 在两件事之间的这段时间里。
chunks.ex_en: Dinner is almost ready; in the meantime, please set the table.
chunks.ex_cn: 晚饭快好了;这期间请把桌子摆好。

chunks.head: knock down
chunks.note: knock sb/sth down = 把某人/某物打倒在地。
chunks.ex_en: The strong wind knocked down the old fence.
chunks.ex_cn: 大风把那道旧栅栏刮倒了。

chunks.head: stock still
chunks.note: stand/stay stock still = 完全静止不动。
chunks.ex_en: The rabbit stood stock still when it heard the noise.
chunks.ex_cn: 听到声响时,那只兔子一动不动地站着。

chunks.head: take prisoner
chunks.note: take sb prisoner = 把某人抓获、俘虏。
chunks.ex_en: The soldiers were taken prisoner after the battle.
chunks.ex_cn: 那场战斗后士兵们被俘。

chunks.head: stark naked
chunks.note: stark naked = 完全裸露(stark 强调'完全')。
chunks.ex_en: The little boy ran out of the bath stark naked.
chunks.ex_cn: 那小男孩光溜溜地跑出了浴室。

chunks.head: first of all
chunks.note: first of all = 列举或叙述时的'首先'。
chunks.ex_en: First of all, let me thank everyone for coming.
chunks.ex_cn: 首先,让我感谢各位的到来。

chunks.head: make it one's business to
chunks.gloss: 把…当作分内之事、专门去做
chunks.note: make it one's business to do sth = 主动担起、专心去做某事。
chunks.ex_en: She made it her business to help every new student settle in.
chunks.ex_cn: 她把帮每个新生适应当作自己的分内事。
